entities.name: Great Wood
entities.description: Forest of Ulgrotha at the western base of the Koskun Mountains that separates them from Aysen.

entities.name: Autumn Willow
entities.description: Sentient avatar and ruler of the Great Wood.

entities.name: Feroz's Ban
entities.description: Barrier that hindered the plane's energy flow and made the forest fertile.

entities.name: Apocalypse Chime
entities.description: Left the rest of the planet a wasteland.

entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: Country whose dissatisfied citizens settled the wood.

entities.name: An-Havva
entities.description: Main pioneer settlement in the wood.

events.summary: When Feroz's Ban starts, the forest's aura becomes sentient and Autumn Willow is born.
events.quote: Autumn Willow , the ruler of the Great Wood, was born

events.summary: Citizens dissatisfied with Aysen's bureaucracy settle the wood, founding the pioneer towns.
events.quote: citizens dissatisfied with the increasing bureaucracy of the country left to build new homes

events.summary: Seeing the settlers are good people, the Autumn Willow opens a guarded path to An-Havva.
events.quote: she opened up a path for them between the Koskun Mountains and their main settlement

relations.quote: Autumn Willow , the ruler of the Great Wood
